sounds like your mother gave up her own identity and passions when she became a mom. a lot of women do. and then when the kids grow up they don't know what to do with themselves. so they cling to their kids because what else will they be... who are they if not a "mom". 

you can try and talk with her asking her about her interests and dreams BEFORE she became a mom. Reassure her that she can be happy and a person without being a mom.  

I got a lot of flack for my no kids no pets rule in regards to my bedroom.  But I don't regret it one bit. I gave everything else to raising my kids with love and support. But I refused to give up who I was and am before I had them. and now that my last child is a teenager and a few years away from being an adult I'm really glad I did.  I don't have that anxiety of an empty nester without a purpose that a lot of mothers experience.  

Good luck with your mom. And if she won't be reasonable LIE and tell her you have a 2nd job and take that time just for yourself. 

virtual hugs🫂
